stem: The ratio of \(p\) to \(q\) is 9 to 4. If \(p = 54\), what is the value of \(q\)?

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(54 - 9 + 4\), treating the ratio as a difference. A ratio of 9 to 4 means \(p\) is \(\frac{9}{4}\) times \(q\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(54 \cdot \frac{9}{4}\), using the ratio upside down. Since \(p : q = 9 : 4\), \(q\) is smaller than \(p\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(54 \cdot 4\), the value of \(9q\), not of \(q\).

verify:
q = symbols('q')
ans = solve(Eq(Rational(54, 1)/q, Rational(9, 4)), q)[0]
assert ans == 24
assert value(choices[answer]) == ans
assert all(value(choices[k]) != ans for k in choices if k != answer)
